reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used supplement bottles, and I know I'd quit this one too. A foil sachet every day also feels like a lot of trash for something I can get in a bottle.
objection: Thirty foil sachets a month is packaging waste, and I'd pay extra for a daily routine I probably won't keep up. A bottle is cheaper per day and I already own stuff I'm not finishing.
would_change_my_mind: A bottle or refill option at around $0.60 a day or less, or sachets that are recyclable.
